summary: Partial exhibit of the Oswald Dome fire tower (built 1935 on Bean Mountain, removed 2003) at the Ocoee Whitewater Center, Polk County, TN; not a standing lookout.

facts.status_note: The tower is no longer on Bean Mountain. A segment of the structure and its cab were restored and set up as an exhibit at the Ocoee Whitewater Center in 2004.

access.note: Roadside exhibit beside U.S. 64 near the Ocoee Whitewater Center. The sources describe no access restriction and no climbing.

visit.trail_note: The exhibit is beside U.S. 64. The original summit is reached by Oswald Dome Road, a Forest Service road, and by trails.

events.note: Built in 1935 and located on Bean Mountain, also called Oswald Dome

corrections.why: The original tower was removed from Bean Mountain in 2003. Only a segment and its cab were set up as an exhibit at the Ocoee Whitewater Center in 2004, and Tennessee Landforms calls it a partial reconstruction.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Tennessee Landforms index lists the POT004 waypoint with an unexplained code (cnf sitting), but its detail page says the Oswald Dome tower was partially reconstructed as an exhibit. This record is treated as the exhibit, not a standing lookout.
The marker gives 2003 for removal and 2004 for relocation; Wikipedia gives only the 2004 move. Both are kept, with 2003 as the removal year.

sources.title: The Heyday for Fire Towers (historical marker)

notes_for_editor: The brief's record (standing, Cherokee National Forest, 376 m) describes the exhibit at the Ocoee Whitewater Center, not a standing lookout. The original Oswald Dome tower summit, about 923 m, has its own record (us-tn-oswald-dome, status relocated), which is consistent with this one. Consider relabelling this record as the exhibit, or merging the two. The marker gives the original height as 79 ft 6 in, but the text in the cache is garbled, so height_m is left out. The exhibit's present condition was not checked on site; the hmdb marker photos are dated July 2025. Used 2 WebSearch calls and 4 new page reads for this tower.
